quests.instruction: You find some money hidden inside an old jacket pocket. How do you feel?
quests.question: Surprised
quests.hint: Discovering something valuable you totally forgot about can make you gasp.
quests.explanation: Discovering something you completely forgot about gives you a fun little jolt of surprise.
quests.funFact: Finding forgotten things in old pockets is a small joy many people know well!

quests.instruction: You finally learn to tie your own shoelaces. How do you feel?
quests.question: Proud
quests.hint: Learning a brand-new skill all by yourself can make you want to show everyone.
quests.explanation: Learning a brand-new skill all by yourself, like tying your shoes, gives you a warm, accomplished feeling.
quests.funFact: Learning to tie shoelaces usually takes lots of practice — every try helps your fingers learn!

quests.instruction: You visit your cousin's house and see relatives you rarely meet. How do you feel?
quests.question: Shy
quests.hint: Seeing family members you do not know very well can make you want to stand close to your parents.
quests.explanation: Seeing family you do not see very often can make you feel a little quiet until you warm up.
quests.funFact: Bringing a favorite small toy or game can help you feel braver around new people!

quests.instruction: You danced through every single song at the party. How do you feel?
quests.question: Tired
quests.hint: Dancing for a long time can leave your legs feeling worn out.
quests.explanation: Dancing through so many songs uses a lot of energy, so your body wants to rest now.
quests.funFact: Dancing is a fun way to exercise your whole body, from your toes to your arms!

quests.instruction: It has been raining outside for three days straight. How do you feel?
quests.question: Bored
quests.hint: Staying inside for a long time with nothing new to do can make time feel very slow.
quests.explanation: Staying inside for days with nothing new to do can make time feel slow and dull.
quests.funFact: Making up a new game with things around the house is a great way to fix this feeling!

quests.instruction: You find a gift hidden under your pillow. How do you feel?
quests.question: Surprised
quests.hint: Finding something unexpected in a place you were not looking feels like a jolt.
quests.explanation: Finding something you never expected, right where you sleep, gives you a fun jolt of surprise!
quests.funFact: Our eyes go a little wider when we notice something we did not expect!

quests.instruction: You finish building a tall block tower all by yourself. How do you feel?
quests.question: Proud
quests.hint: Finishing something you worked hard on can make your chest puff up a little.
quests.explanation: Finishing something you built all by yourself gives you a warm, accomplished feeling inside.
quests.funFact: Building tall towers helps you practice balance and careful thinking!

quests.instruction: You have to read your story out loud to the class. How do you feel?
quests.question: Shy
quests.hint: Reading out loud in front of everyone can make your voice feel a little quiet.
quests.explanation: Reading out loud with everyone listening can make your voice feel small and quiet at first.
quests.funFact: Practicing a story at home first can help this quiet feeling shrink a little.

quests.instruction: You played outside all day in the summer sun. How do you feel?
quests.question: Tired
quests.hint: A whole day of running in the sun can leave your body feeling heavy and slow.
quests.explanation: A full day of playing outside uses lots of energy, so your body feels worn out by evening.
quests.funFact: Drinking water after playing in the sun helps your tired body feel better faster!

quests.instruction: You finished all your puzzles and there is nothing left to do. How do you feel?
quests.question: Bored
quests.hint: Running out of things to solve can leave your afternoon feeling empty.
quests.explanation: Running out of things to do can leave the rest of your afternoon feeling slow and dull.
quests.funFact: Flipping a finished puzzle over and mixing it up is a fun way to try it again!

quests.instruction: You open the door and all your friends shout, 'Surprise!' How do you feel?
quests.question: Surprised
quests.hint: Something you did not expect at all just happened right in front of you.
quests.explanation: When something unexpected happens all at once, like friends shouting together, it gives you a big jump of surprise!
quests.funFact: Your body can react to a surprise before your brain even finishes understanding what happened!

quests.instruction: You clean your room without anyone asking you to. How do you feel?
quests.question: Proud
quests.hint: Doing something responsible on your own, without being asked, can feel really good.
quests.explanation: Doing something responsible all on your own gives you a warm feeling of accomplishment.
quests.funFact: Doing chores without being asked is a big step in growing more responsible!

quests.instruction: A new kid asks if you want to play, and you feel unsure what to say. How do you feel?
quests.question: Shy
quests.hint: Not knowing someone yet can make it hard to find the right words to answer.
quests.explanation: Not knowing someone yet can make it feel hard to find the right words, even for a simple answer.
quests.funFact: Saying 'yes, what do you want to play?' is a simple way to start a new friendship!

quests.instruction: You just walked all the way home from school. How do you feel?
quests.question: Tired
quests.hint: A long walk can make your feet feel heavy by the time you get home.
quests.explanation: Walking a long distance uses up energy, so your legs and feet feel worn out.
quests.funFact: Walking is one of the easiest ways to keep your body healthy and strong!

quests.instruction: You have read the same book five times this week. How do you feel?
quests.question: Bored
quests.hint: A story you already know every word of can start to feel less exciting.
quests.explanation: Reading the very same story again and again can start to feel dull after a while.
quests.funFact: Picking a brand-new book from the library shelf is a fun cure for this feeling!

quests.instruction: You open a cereal box and find a toy you did not know was inside. How do you feel?
quests.question: Surprised
quests.hint: Finding something extra you were not expecting can make you gasp with delight.
quests.explanation: Finding an extra little treasure you were not expecting gives you a fun jolt of surprise.
quests.funFact: Cereal box toys have been a fun surprise for kids for almost 100 years!

quests.instruction: You practice all week and read a whole book by yourself. How do you feel?
quests.question: Proud
quests.hint: Finishing something you worked hard at practicing feels like a real achievement.
quests.explanation: Practicing all week and then finishing a whole book gives you a warm sense of achievement.
quests.funFact: Every book you finish helps you become an even stronger reader!

quests.instruction: You join a new club where you do not know anyone yet. How do you feel?
quests.question: Shy
quests.hint: Walking into a room full of strangers can make you want to stand near the door.
quests.explanation: Walking into a room full of new faces can make you feel a little unsure and quiet.
quests.funFact: Asking one simple question is a great way to start talking to someone new!

quests.instruction: You swam in the pool for hours this afternoon. How do you feel?
quests.question: Tired
quests.hint: Swimming uses lots of muscles, so your arms might feel heavy afterward.
quests.explanation: Swimming for a long time uses a lot of energy, so your whole body feels ready to rest.
quests.funFact: Swimming works almost every muscle in your body, which is why it is so tiring — and so healthy!

quests.instruction: Your friends are busy and there is no one to play with. How do you feel?
quests.question: Bored
quests.hint: An afternoon with no one around to play with can feel very slow and quiet.
quests.explanation: An afternoon with no one to play with can feel slow and a little dull.
quests.funFact: This can be a great time to try a brand-new hobby all on your own!

quests.instruction: Your teacher gives the whole class extra recess out of nowhere. How do you feel?
quests.question: Surprised
quests.hint: Getting unplanned good news with zero warning can make your eyes go wide.
quests.explanation: Getting unplanned good news with no warning at all gives you a happy jolt of surprise.
quests.funFact: Unexpected good news often feels even better than good news you were already waiting for!

quests.instruction: You help your grandma carry her grocery bags inside. How do you feel?
quests.question: Proud
quests.hint: Being helpful to someone you love can make you feel like a real helper.
quests.explanation: Being helpful to someone you love gives you a warm feeling of accomplishment.
quests.funFact: Small acts of helping can make a big difference to the people we love!

quests.instruction: It is your first day at a brand new school. How do you feel?
quests.question: Shy
quests.hint: Being somewhere new where nobody knows you yet can make you want to stay quiet.
quests.explanation: Being somewhere brand new, where no one knows you yet, can make you feel a little quiet and unsure.
quests.funFact: Almost everyone feels this way on a first day — it usually gets easier once you make one friend!

quests.instruction: You helped clean the whole house this morning. How do you feel?
quests.question: Tired
quests.hint: A lot of sweeping and tidying can make your arms feel a little heavy.
quests.explanation: Cleaning takes a lot of moving and effort, so your body feels ready for a rest afterward.
quests.funFact: Helping out at home is great exercise, even though it does not look like a workout!

quests.instruction: It is a quiet afternoon with nothing planned at all. How do you feel?
quests.question: Bored
quests.hint: A whole afternoon with no plans and nothing new can feel very slow.
quests.explanation: An afternoon with nothing planned can sometimes feel slow and a little dull.
quests.funFact: This can be the perfect time to invent a brand-new game of your own!

quests.instruction: Your dog does a funny new trick nobody ever taught it. How do you feel?
quests.question: Surprised
quests.hint: Watching a pet do something you never expected can make you gasp and laugh.
quests.explanation: Watching a pet do something totally unexpected gives you a fun little jolt of surprise.
quests.funFact: Pets sometimes learn tricks just by watching and copying the people around them!

quests.instruction: You practice your times tables and get them all correct. How do you feel?
quests.question: Proud
quests.hint: Getting every single one right after lots of practice feels like a real accomplishment.
quests.explanation: Getting every answer right after practicing hard gives you a warm feeling of accomplishment.
quests.funFact: Practicing math a little bit every day helps your brain remember it better!

quests.instruction: You have to say your name in front of the whole class. How do you feel?
quests.question: Shy
quests.hint: Having every eye in the room on you can make your cheeks feel warm.
quests.explanation: Having everyone's eyes on you all at once can make you feel a little quiet and unsure inside.
quests.funFact: Taking a deep breath before speaking can help this quiet feeling feel smaller.

quests.instruction: You rode your bike for a very long trail today. How do you feel?
quests.question: Tired
quests.hint: Pedaling for a long distance can make your legs feel heavy afterward.
quests.explanation: Riding your bike for a long trail uses lots of leg power, so your body feels worn out after.
quests.funFact: Biking is a fun way to build strong leg muscles while exploring new places!

quests.instruction: You are waiting at the doctor's office with no toys around. How do you feel?
quests.question: Bored
quests.hint: Sitting in a plain room with nothing to play with can make time crawl by slowly.
quests.explanation: Sitting somewhere plain with nothing to do can make the wait feel slow and dull.
quests.funFact: Looking for shapes or patterns on the walls or floor can help pass a quiet wait.
